# Fixed board references

Eight unmodified source/license files, verified against the pinned local Git objects. No vendor runtime changes.

AppFlowy original `GroupSetting`, single-select option-ID membership, field-ID no-status group, `merge_groups` order and retained visibility define the database adapter. `dataset/rust/src/board.rs` derives their bounded PB-free projection and preserves unknown configuration as read-only. Original field/cell codecs, independent row CRDTs, undo and realtime transport remain in use.

SiYuan `ViewGroup` and `KanbanCard.ID` are the product alignment reference. This slice covers single-select grouped cards; it does not claim number/date grouping, cover settings, full card layout configuration or complete five-layout parity.
